scope: Freshness and event-driven reopening of AI-project-method research used by the personal Paper V1 project.

event_triggers.description: principal model, agent runtime, compaction behavior, or orchestration tool changes
a decision-bearing source is revised, retracted, removed, or materially contradicted
a field failure is observed that is not represented by the current failure graph
a control produces repeated false positives, false negatives, bypasses, or excessive burden
the project becomes multi-user or changes its privacy, paper-only, or execution-authority boundary
the fixed same-task comparison materially contradicts a current method decision

network_contract.successful_verification_means: tracked bytes, review receipt, date arithmetic, and event state are internally valid
network_contract.successful_verification_does_not_mean: the internet was searched, sources remain externally current, claims are true, or the product is complete
